scripts.check-auth: gcloud auth application-default print-access-token > /dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'Not authenticated. Running gcloud auth application-default login...' && gcloud auth application-default login)
scripts.deploy: yarn load-env gcloud functions deploy watchDriveChanges --runtime nodejs22 --trigger-http --region us-east1 --entry-point watchDriveChanges --no-allow-unauthenticated --service-account=$(gcloud secrets versions access latest --secret=GOOGLE_CLOUD_SERVICE_ACCOUNT) --set-env-vars NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_PROJECT_ID=ilp5p0ny,NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_DATASET=production,NEXT_PUBLIC_SANITY_API_VERSION=2024-06-21 --set-secrets=SANITY_API_WRITE_TOKEN=SANITY_API_WRITE_TOKEN:latest,GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID=GOOGLE_DRIVE_FOLDER_ID:latest --timeout=3600
